Phase 0 dispatch (interactive session, owner: this chat session on the VM).

User asks (verbatim):
- "Use the lean path: skip /adversarial-planner for this one (I'm overriding the EPS planning rule). Turn the design into a task, then run Phase 0 only and report the gate results before the core."
- Compute answer: "Auto lane, 4 GPUs (Recommended)".
- Launch approval: "Launch Phase 0 on the auto lane (GCP first, RunPod fallback). Worst case about $105 on RunPod is OK."

Scope: Phase 0 only (9 runs: faithful_{cat,neutral}_s1, const_{cat,neutral}_s{1,2,3}, prefix_cat_s1_1ep). Phase 1 core does NOT launch from this dispatch. Gate results get reported to the user first.

Code: branch issue-2674 @ 461c7608823897183bac175f5b38b960af14ee01 (22/22 unit checks, ruff clean).

Compute estimate (4 GPUs):
- FLOPs-floor check: ~5 useful GPU-h, ~3 h wall, ~12 billed GPU-h (~$40 on RunPod 4xH100 at $13.16/hr).
- Implementer's pessimistic estimate after the step-0 trim: ~26-33 billed GPU-h (~$90-105 on RunPod). Above the 20 GPU-h line, so the user confirmed it in chat (quoted above).
- GCP A100 lane: credits only, ~2x the wall.

Ops arithmetic: gen = 8 teacher shards; train = 9 runs x (3 epochs x 152 steps, prefix run 152 steps); eval = 34 adapters + base, 50 plain q x 100 samples + 50 prefix q x 200 samples each, temp 1, max_tokens 2048.
Parallelization: 4-wide work-conserving GPU queue for gen shards (8), training runs (9), and eval processes (9).

Lane: auto (gcp -> runpod -> ...). --spot-tolerant NOT set: phase sentinels live on the instance disk, and a GCP preemption deletes the instance, so spot would restart from zero.
Fences: --max-run-duration 36h (GCP auto-delete), --time-budget-hours 30.
On a RunPod fall-through, the launch only provisions the pod; this session starts the workload separately.

Monitoring: plain shell poller from this session (no LLM calls). The experiment watchdog is NOT registered (no acknowledged notification helper configured), so the run is not safely unattended. If this session dies, a GCP instance self-deletes at 36h; a RunPod pod keeps billing until terminated.
Lean path (user override of /adversarial-planner). Phase 0 approved in chat; see epm:progress dispatch note.
